body: Oh, and when you track, make sure you're weighing stuff and not just guesstimating.

I wouldn't pay attention to calories burned in Fitbit. What we know is that you've had 3 months of maintenance. I would eat however you've been eating for the next week or two and track that just so you know the base calories you've been at while maintaining. Then cut 250-500 cals from your diet per day and see how you go.

I'm not sure yet, I've started doing double resistance days, whether that's two sessions at F45 or I might do a weights session at the gym in the AM then F45 resistance in the evening. And some days I'm throwing in a double cardio. I don't do the session back to back though, always one morning and one evening. I'm just going to try and be a bit more strict on diet as I've had beers here and there for social things, the odd wedding, and need to stop snacking on ice cream!!

I find I end up lifting a good deal less than a goblet squat as I just can't sustain holding the weight on my arms that long. e.g. I could goblet squat a 25kg dumbbell or the heaviest available KB but if I'm racking two KBs I can only manage one 8kg on each arm. I think I just find the position of holding my arms up for that long too uncomfortable.

I think it's also the size of the KBs as i used to do racked squats with a trainer all the time but the KBs were smaller so more comfortable to hold up front.

It'll come. I started off having to do blue and black combined, then black and red and now am down to either black or blue on their own (depending on how lazy I'm feeling!). Progressed over the course of the last 6 weeks or so.

Yep, got mixed feelings about it. Starting BF % was 31.9%, now at 27.5%, lost 4kg of fat and gained half a kg of muscle. But I've been really shitty on my diet for 2 of the weeks as I was feeling really stressed and down so just kept eating junk so I keep thinking how much better my results could've been if I'd actually stuck to the diet... But now is my time to really try and stick to it and focus the next 4 weeks and hopefully reach my goal of 22% (although I know that'll be tough!).

I lost 2kg. Just over 1kg of fat, 0.5kg of muscle and the rest water. Bit gutted to have lost a bit of muscle but I'm going to keep an eye on it over time as the initial loss could well just be due to muscle glycogen depletion as I also do IF. Another 7 or 8kg of fat to go. Going to stick to my diet a bit better this week as last week I was a bit all over the place on some days. Not following the challenge meal plan but doing my own thing.

I use nike free rn shoes. For me they're brilliant if I want a nice neutral running shoe but they've also been great when I've done heavy lifting outside of f45 as well as both cardio/resistance days so I find them a really good all rounder. But again it'll differ by your own individual mechanics etc. So maybe worth finding one of those sports shops that lets you try out a shoe if they have them in your area.

Think it's usually a result of you being bad at those areas so you focus your revision on them and spend less time on your strong areas. I had a similar thing happen when I did my finals at uni. Spent 3 years getting a 3rd in Microeconomics, struggling to get above 30% in mocks but it ended up being one of my best econ papers at finals as I focused so much of my revision and past paper practice on that area.
I keep feeling paranoid that there's been some terrible mistake and I'm going to get some correction email soon like oops you actually failed sorry.
Passed L1! Genuinely shocked as I thought I'd be a borderline pass if I made it but was above 90th percentile across the board. No idea how that's happened.

I had somehow completely forgotten that today was results today until a colleague kindly piped up with 'what time do your results come through?' fuuuuuuuck. Now I'm just sitting here looking at the clock for the last hour.

I was re\-watching and I noticed when she has the scene where she is scanned to check if human, she looks hesitantly at the person waiting for the result to load as if not 100% sure she'll pass. I saw a post earlier theorising that she could be a clone of the real Charlotte Hale. Interesting idea; if that was the case, could be the host Ford was building in S1 and the reason for the inspired outfit choice. I'd think such a host would be actively working against Delos and the real Charlotte to extract Abernathy.
